name: webmcp
description: webmcp monorepo — community implementation of the W3C WebMCP API (@thegreataxios/webmcp*)

scripts.build: bun run --filter '@thegreataxios/webmcp-core' build && bun run --filter '@thegreataxios/webmcp-bridge' build && bun run --filter '@thegreataxios/webmcp-react' build && bun run --filter '@thegreataxios/webmcp' build
scripts.test: bun run --filter '@thegreataxios/webmcp-core' test && bun run --filter '@thegreataxios/webmcp-bridge' test && bun run --filter '@thegreataxios/webmcp-react' test && bun run --filter '@thegreataxios/webmcp' test
